answer: For a poll on the hollow jetty sculpture titled zenith, officials lock a separate $10 sponsor bond per ballot and reject unfunded ballots. They count funded ballots unless a rostered sponsor signs an election- and ballot-bound confession of sponsoring a sybil. Officials verify the signature against the roster, reject confessed ballots and forfeit their bonds; they refund the rest. Extra ballots tie up $10 each. Sponsors can stay silent, and false confessions can suppress genuine votes.
